others.route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour and Skills)

note: Ethiopia: under the Labour Proclamation No. 1156/2019, article 176(1), a foreigner may be employed in any work only on a work permit the Ministry gives (the labour ministry, now the Ministry of Labour and Skills); a visa isn't permission to work. Foreign nationals of Ethiopian origin, who may work without a permit, aren't modelled apart; no performers' exemption and no days are named. Read in UNHCR's Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform, which quotes the article; the ministry's site and NATLEX didn't answer this client.

sources.title: UNHCR, Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform: Labor Proclamation No 1156/2019 (Ethiopia)
sources.said: Article 176(1) Employment of Foreign Nationals Any foreigner may only be employed in any type of work in Ethiopia where he possesses a work permit given to him by the Ministry.
